description: Envelope generator and VCA, after the EMS VCS3, with a CV input for every knob

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise from 0V to full, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope holds at full before it begins to fall, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall back to 0V, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope stays at 0V at the end of the cycle, 1ms to 10 seconds
Scales the height of the envelope outputs, 0 to 100%
Sets the gain the input signal passes through, 0 to 10 times, so most of its travel amplifies
Starts the envelope cycle, on every polyphonic channel at once
1X runs the four stage times as marked on their knobs; 10X multiplies all four by ten, for stages of up to 100 seconds
STOP ends the envelope after the off stage; LOOP begins the next cycle immediately

inputs.text: The signal sent through the VCA
A rising edge starts the envelope cycle; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
0-10V scaling the attack time, so 0V shortens that stage to 1ms
0-10V scaling the on time, so 0V shortens that stage to 1ms
0-10V scaling the decay time, so 0V shortens that stage to 1ms
0-10V scaling the off time, so 0V shortens that stage to 1ms
0-10V scaling the ENV knob setting, so 0V flattens the envelope outputs
0-10V scaling the SIGNAL knob setting, so 0V closes the VCA

outputs.text: The input signal after the VCA, at the gain set by SIGNAL and shaped by the envelope
The trapezoid envelope, 0-10V at full height
10V minus the envelope, so it falls as the envelope rises
A 1ms 5V pulse when the off stage completes
Plus a gate output per stage, high for the duration of that stage

menu: Resume loop on load — an envelope that was looping when the patch was saved starts looping again when the patch is loaded
